text: He insisted on paying for the meal himself.
note: insist on + 名词/动名词 = 坚持。

text: She insisted on coming with us that night.
translation: 她坚持那晚跟我们一起去。

text: My parents insisted on driving me to the station.
translation: 我父母坚持开车送我去车站。

text: They insisted on staying until the work was done.
translation: 他们坚持待到工作做完。

text: He insisted that the report was wrong.
translation: 他坚决主张那份报告是错的。
note: insist that + 声明 = 坚决主张。

text: She insisted that she had never seen the man.
translation: 她坚称自己从没见过那个人。

text: They insisted that the door had been open all night.
translation: 他们坚称门整夜都是开着的。
note: insist that = 坚决主张（不承认相反）。

text: He insisted that the plan was better than yours.
translation: 他坚决主张那个计划比你的好。

text: The teacher insisted on the need for clear rules.
translation: 老师强调明确规则的必要性。
note: insist on + 名词 = 强调。

text: He insisted on the fact that she had already paid.
translation: 他强调她已经付过钱这一事实。
note: insist on the fact = 强调。

text: At the end he insisted on one simple point.
translation: 最后他强调了一个简单的要点。
note: insist on a point = 强调。

text: My grandfather insists on the value of hard work.
translation: 我祖父强调勤劳的价值。
note: insist on the value of = 强调。

text: She insisted on seeing the doctor at once.
He insisted that he had seen the whole thing.
translation: 他坚称他看到了整个过程。

text: My uncle insists on the value of small meals.
translation: 我叔叔强调少量多餐的价值。
note: insist on the value = 强调。
